grh_b08308b0801f401c1f3d.title: Anna Norquist
paragraphs: Anna Norquist comes from Sweden to marry Pete after two years of courtship by letter, only to find him convicted of murdering Seth Quincy during a robbery. Pete continues to protest his innocence, and Anna's faith in him turns into bitter distrust of the American justice system. Britt finds Pete's hidden, recently fired gun and persuades him to stop letting Anna believe an innocent man is being condemned. Pete finally confesses that he tried to rob Quincy for money to start married life with Anna and shot him when he was caught. After learning the truth, Anna remains in Smoke Falls and begins a new life there.

grh_b0acd0c538d0301773a8.title: Big Mr Little
paragraphs: After a drunken mixture, an ordinary little man discovers that whatever destructive thing he wishes aloud immediately happens, from a falling elevator to fatal accidents. A doctor proves the power can also work for good when a wish restores a blind newsdealer’s sight, but the newly empowered man instead plans to blackmail governments and industrial leaders by threatening death. The doctor and his wife pretend to cooperate until they turn the man’s own failure to respect them against him and end his reign before he can impose himself on the world.

grh_b0bfa87a68e004815c8f.title: The Noon Stars
paragraphs: A rigid, joyless town becomes disturbed by a strange, happy boy who claims he can see stars even in daylight. Reverend Samuel and other leaders turn the child's difference into evidence of sin and encourage the townspeople to fear him, while a few residents try to protect him. After violence drives the boy away, the real stars disappear from the night sky, then even the moon begins fading. The frightened townspeople finally decide they must find and bring him back, only to discover that the road leading out of town has become overgrown and impassable, trapping them in the darkness their intolerance created.
